name: Dynamic Neural Radiance Fields (TöRF)
definition: A dynamic neural radiance field approach using two neural networks (static and dynamic) to model measurements from a moving color camera and C-ToF camera pair, enabling high-fidelity novel-view synthesis of dynamic scenes.
summary: TöRF is a dynamic neural radiance field method that reconstructs scenes by optimizing against raw Time-of-Flight phasors and RGB images, enabling high-fidelity novel-view synthesis from moving cameras without relying on processed depth maps.
